how_its_made:
**Problem**

Censorship @Twitter and PolygonDapp integration Web2/Web3 

**Solution**

Deploy the tweet @polygon with the URI as the IPFS of the snapshot tweet and query transactions and Nft using a Discord BOT.



The main use case is that a user can own the tweets through an ERC721 contract @ Polygon network using TweetID and the uploaded tweet as IPFS as URI. At this point, the user will be able to query the available TweetsID and view them through the different APIs provided by the event sponsors such as Covalent, NFTPort and also PolygonScan API. 

Finally, we integrate Web3 Discord Bot to query the @Polygon Network using DiscordJS
